sections: Vol3C28.7.3 Delivery of Pending Debug Exceptions after VM Entry
verified_contract: VM entry injecting an external interrupt or NMI clears pending debug exceptions
Valid pending debug traps require BS bit14 or enabled-breakpoint bit12
An unblocked pending debug trap has priority over IRQ and NMI and updates DR6 on delivery
MOV-SS blocking suppresses debug delivery; STI blocking does not suppress debug traps
